offers_products.reason: Sells liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry instruments, consumables such as columns and vials, and software.

offers_services.reason: Offers instrument service and support contracts alongside its systems, described as analytical technologies, informatics, and service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are labs and scientists in pharma, food, water testing and research; no household buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to pharmaceutical firms, biotech manufacturers, food and water testing labs, universities and research institutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat consumables (columns, vials, standards), service contracts and software support make up most revenue from installed instruments.

cyclical_demand.reason: Regulated, high-volume pharma, food and water testing is needed regardless of the economy, though instrument purchases can slip.

big_ticket.reason: Instruments are large purchases, but most revenue is smaller recurring consumables and service.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for instruments, consumables and software; the technology, not staff time, is the product.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large pharmaceutical and biopharma companies, big testing labs and government or academic institutions.

asset_heavy.reason: Precision instrument manufacturing and R&D need moderate capital, not heavy plants or networks; asset-light compared with utilities or fleets.

notes: Waters combined with BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions in 2026; answers reflect the core Waters business and may shift for the combined firm.
